###### Microbial community analyses
##### Alpha diversity analysis

library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2) 
library(RColorBrewer)
count <- read.csv("countdata.csv",header=T,row.names=1)
meta <- read.csv("metadata.csv",header=T,row.names=1)
ps <- phyloseq(otu_table(count, taxa_are_rows=TRUE), 
               sample_data(meta))
ps
p <- plot_richness(ps, "Origin", color = "Origin", measures = c("Shannon","Simpson"))
p + geom_boxplot(aes(x=Origin, colour = Origin)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +                             
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(), 
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black"),
    
    # Facet strip formatting
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    
    # Axis text for the numeric axis (bottom after flip)
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    
    # Legend
    legend.position = "none"
  )  +     
  # Use element_markdown for the axis that now shows plant names (y-axis after flip)
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18))


##### Beta diversity analysis
#### Rhizosphere-wise:

library(ade4)
library("factoextra")
library(dplyr)
c <- read.csv("countdata_plant.csv",row.names=1)
meta <- read.csv("metadata_plant.csv")
identical(colnames(c),meta$Sample)
library(microbiome)
transform <- microbiome::transform
rel <- transform(c, "compositional")
rel2 <- as.matrix(t(rel))
my_colors <- c(
  "red", "blue", "darkgreen", "purple")
res.pca <- dudi.pca(rel2,
                    scannf = FALSE, nf = 5)
groups <- as.factor(meta$Plant)
s.class(res.pca$li,                                                  
        fac = groups,  # color by groups
        col = my_colors, clabel = 0)
group_colors <- my_colors
fviz_pca_ind(res.pca,
             col.ind = groups,
             palette = group_colors,
             addEllipses = FALSE,
             mean.point = FALSE,
             repel = TRUE,
             label = "none",
             pointsize = 2,
             pointshape = 19,
             alpha.ind = 0.7) +
  labs(color = "Plants") +   # <-- new legend title
  theme_bw() + theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, family = "Arial"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, family = "Arial"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, family = "Arial"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, family = "Arial"),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, family = "Arial"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18, family = "Arial"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16, family = "Arial", face = "italic"),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.5, color = "gray40")
  )
rand1 <- randtest(bca(res.pca, groups, scan = FALSE), 999)
rand1

####Soil-wise

library(ade4)
library("factoextra")
library(dplyr)
c <- read.csv("countdata_soil.csv",row.names=1)
meta <- read.csv("metadata_soil.csv")
identical(colnames(c),meta$Sample)
library(microbiome)
transform <- microbiome::transform
rel <- transform(c, "compositional")
rel2 <- as.matrix(t(rel))
my_colors <- c(
  "red", "blue", "darkgreen", "orange", "purple",
  "brown", "pink", "cyan", "magenta", "gold",
  "limegreen", "tomato")
res.pca <- dudi.pca(rel2,
                    scannf = FALSE, nf = 5)
groups <- as.factor(meta$Region)
s.class(res.pca$li,                                                  
        fac = groups,  # color by groups
        col = my_colors, clabel = 0)
group_colors <- my_colors
fviz_pca_ind(res.pca,
             col.ind = groups,
             palette = group_colors,
             addEllipses = FALSE,
             mean.point = FALSE,
             repel = TRUE,
             label = "none",
             pointsize = 2,
             pointshape = 19,
             alpha.ind = 0.7) +
  labs(color = "Sampling location") +   # <-- new legend title
  theme_bw() + theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, family = "Arial"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, family = "Arial"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, family = "Arial"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, family = "Arial"),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, family = "Arial"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18, family = "Arial"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16, family = "Arial"),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.5, color = "gray40")
  )
rand1 <- randtest(bca(res.pca, groups, scan = FALSE), 999)
rand1
